def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    a_strand = [state[i] for i in range(0, n, 2)]
    b_strand = [state[i] for i in range(1, n, 2)]
    last_a = a_strand[-1]
    last_b = b_strand[-1]
    if n % 2 == 0:
        # Appending to A-strand (even index): use strand-sum
        new_element = (last_a + last_b) % 8
    else:
        # Appending to B-strand (odd index): use strand-XOR
        len_a = len(a_strand)
        new_element = (last_a ^ last_b ^ len_a) % 8
    return state + [new_element]
